title: Feedback on this project's reviews
subtitle: What people accepted and rejected across every PR review, and what the reviewer learned from it.
empty: No feedback yet. Accept or reject findings to teach the reviewer this project's conventions.
rulesHint: A kind of finding rejected {{threshold}} times more than accepted is downgraded to low; twice that, it is hidden. Security and critical findings are never touched.
noRules: No kind of finding has been rejected often enough to change the reviews.
resetHint: Reset forgets the verdicts given so far on that kind of finding: the reviewer raises it again until it is rejected again.

conventions.hint: Writes the rules deduced from this feedback to .workpilot/review-conventions.md, without any model. The same feedback always gives the same file.

errors.invalid: This request could not be read.
errors.not_found: This project or this kind of finding was not found.
errors.server_project: Feedback on findings is not available for server projects yet.
errors.write_failed: The file could not be written.
